source_discovery_timing: Prior to this prereg I already saw paper bibliographic entry, PubMed abstract, N=31, treatment of dyadic smile alignment, main GitHub README and external Internet Archive link; do NOT claim discovery preregistered. Frozen test is original full methods/data eligibility and ESBM rival mechanism.

A.question: Is there a real experimentally manipulated, directly dyadic interaction mechanism that changes attraction/acceptance and cannot be reduced to static ex ante Q or mere exposure sorting? If so, is the original usable microdata independently accessible with rights?
A.unit: Speed dating 4-minute video dyad and participant-level attraction evaluations, clustered by repeat participant; paper source original.
A.population: Only recruited volunteer sample; initial abstract indicates 31 singles, not Spanish platform.
A.treatment: Congruent vs incongruent smile manipulation of both sides during real-time video
A.outcome: Authors' ratings of attraction/liking and reported mating choice; precise scales and timing to inspect.
A.control: Other manipulated smile alignments (e.g. both down vs one up-one down) and participant/dyad effects, not naïve independent encounters.
A.harm: No covert face-video participant reidentification or bypassing ethical protections.

B.H1: Randomized dyadic smile coordination influences in-interaction attraction above stable preexisting agent quality or platform sorting.
B.H0: Only absolute smile-enhancement or individual actor trait drives outcome; congruent interaction effect disappears in proper contrast.
B.H_other: Repeated participants and assignment dependence, carryover order, no durable pair formation, noisy self-ratings, and experiment constrained to video affect.

required_evidence: Read primary original paper full PDF after prereg; inspect intervention schedule, randomization unit, controls, exact sample/dyads/outcome and effect estimate/uncertainty
Check separate positive vs negative congruent conditions, not claim any congruence automatically attractive
Check original GitHub code and exact data availability and rights; avoid third-party NDA or data claims
Compare preexisting ESBM interaction stage and Fisman/Columbia/Mixmosa baselines and treat effect as externally published—not new ESBM discovery
C.pass: Only count N80 if original trial and source/code yield genuinely discriminating causal interaction mechanism with identifiable control plus robust adversarial limits; otherwise remain NOT_EXECUTED.

D: D1.1 possible addition of in-interaction micro-behavior stage rather than same recommendation parametrization

adversaries: Potential main effect of smiles vs congruence
Experiment manipulation of display vs natural interactions
Attraction score vs mutually accepted match/long relationship
Possible protocol disclosure and ethics constraints
Shared subjects across treatment exposures, carryover
Data archive unreachable; scripts are not participant data

G.independent_replication: Not planned: original randomized study external to ESBM and not an ESBM replication

H.action: Qualitative source-backed prior update or justified no-change, no fabricated numeric Bayes posterior.

I.new_grade: 0/3 unless own original independent test executed

J.decision: Proceed only with original documentary discriminant source; R5 stop if no independent raw data to test ESBM; after one documentary cycle leave N81–N86 untouched.

selection_exposure: Abstract and GitHub README used to motivate source; confirmatory claim forbidden.
